Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the WebSurfer’s results for “Dilan 1991,” conflating the “1991” in the title with the release year and incorrectly stating a 1991 release (even citing a spurious Feb 24 date). The sources shown indicated it is a 2019 film (IMDb: released Feb 28, 2019). This misreading led to the wrong conclusion that “Dilan 1991” came out first, whereas “Celine: Through The Eyes Of The World” (2010) actually did.
